summary: Configured node1 as the internal DNS resolver and node2 to use it. End-to-end resolution and persistence were verified after sequential reboots of both nodes.
actions_performed: Configured inventory-api.internal to resolve to node2 at 10.100.131.11.
Configured node2 to prefer node1 at 10.100.131.10 through persistent DHCP client settings.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 runs an internal DNS resolver resolving inventory-api.internal to node2
evidence.summary: dnsmasq listens on node1 TCP/UDP port 53 and returns 10.100.131.11 for inventory-api.internal, including after restart.

evidence.requirement: node2 uses node1 for internal DNS lookups
evidence.summary: node2 prefers nameserver 10.100.131.10; DiG identifies that server and returns the correct A record after restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on Ubuntu 7.10 with kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.
